name: WE-033 Kestland Household Support Payment (loop seed)

unclear.text: What a household is: persons living together at one address and sharing living expenses; the Tax Agency's first guidance pays by tax-filing unit.
readings: U1-a: one payment per registered address
U1-b: one payment per tax-filing unit, so an address with an adult child or a lodger who files separately receives two

a4.text: The installments are funded mainly by higher taxes rather than lower spending.

a5.text: Some households borrow against the expected payment before it arrives.

a11.text: The bonds are repaid on the ten-year schedule rather than rolled over.

j1.text: The installments are funded mainly by lower spending rather than higher taxes.
